displayedInputs.question: Una rolls \(6\) standard \(6\)-sided dice simultaneously and calculates the product of the \(6\) numbers obtained. What is the probability that the product is divisible by \(4?\)

For \(n\) a positive integer, let \(f(n)\) be the quotient obtained when the sum of all positive divisors of \(n\) is divided by \(n.\) For example, \[ \begin{aligned} f(14) &= (1 + 2 + 7 + 14) \div 14 \\ &= \dfrac{12}{7}. \end{aligned} \] What is \(f(768) - f(384)?\)

Let \(c = \dfrac{2\pi}{11}.\) What is the value of \[\small \dfrac{\sin 3c \cdot \sin 6c \cdot \sin 9c \cdot \sin 12c \cdot \sin 15c}{\sin c \cdot \sin 2c \cdot \sin 3c \cdot \sin 4c \cdot \sin 5c}?\]

Suppose that \(P(z),\) \(Q(z),\) and \(R(z)\) are polynomials with real coefficients, having degrees \(2,\) \(3,\) and \(6,\) respectively, and constant terms \(1,\) \(2,\) and \(3,\) respectively. Let \(N\) be the number of distinct complex numbers \(z\) that satisfy the equation \[P(z) \cdot Q(z) = R(z).\] What is the minimum possible value of \(N?\)

Suppose \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c\) are positive integers such that \[a + b + c = 23\] and \[ \begin{aligned} &\gcd(a, b) + \gcd(b, c) \\ &\quad {}+ \gcd(c, a) = 9. \end{aligned} \] What is the sum of all possible distinct values of \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2?\)

A bug starts at a vertex of a grid made of equilateral triangles of side length \(1.\) At each step the bug moves in one of the \(6\) possible directions along the grid lines randomly and independently with equal probability. What is the probability that after \(5\) moves the bug never will have been more than \(1\) unit away from the starting position?

Set \(u_0 = \dfrac{1}{4},\) and for \(k \ge 0\) let \(u_{k+1}\) be determined by the recurrence \[u_{k+1} = 2u_k - 2u_k^2.\] This sequence tends to a limit; call it \(L.\) What is the least value of \(k\) such that \[|u_k - L| \le \dfrac{1}{2^{1000}}?\]

Regular polygons with \(5,\) \(6,\) \(7,\) and \(8\) sides are inscribed in the same circle. No two of the polygons share a vertex, and no three of their sides intersect at a common point. At how many points inside the circle do two of their sides intersect?

A cube is constructed from \(4\) white unit cubes and \(4\) blue unit cubes. How many different ways are there to construct the \(2 \times 2 \times 2\) cube using these smaller cubes? (Two constructions are considered the same if one can be rotated to match the other.)

For real numbers \(x,\) let \[ \begin{aligned} P(x) &= 1 + \cos(x) + i\sin(x) \\ &\quad {}- \cos(2x) - i\sin(2x) \\ &\quad {}+ \cos(3x) + i\sin(3x) \end{aligned} \] where \(i = \sqrt{-1}.\) For how many values of \(x\) with \(0 \le x \lt 2\pi\) does \[P(x) = 0?\]
